answer: At dawn each agent in the economy pays a real stake to register its key, so spawning a million fake identities costs a fortune instead of nothing. Peer attestations work like orchard keepers marking fruit they personally watched ripen: a vote only counts when the attestor can point to work it actually verified. Misbehavior gets the bad tree slashed and pruned. Reputation thus flows through one guarded inlet, a lagoon joined to the sea by a single tide gate, and sybil armies find the channel priced far beyond their budget.
